title: 국회의원청가및결석에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text: Article 2 (Submission of Application for Leave) Where a Member is unable to attend the National Assembly due to an unavoidable circumstance, the Member shall submit in advance to the Speaker an application for leave stating the reason for, and the period of, the requested leave.
